deadline.quote: Important Dates 2026-2027 QuestBridge National College Match: Application deadline: October 1. Matches released: December 1. Single-Choice Early Action: Application deadline: November 1. Decisions released: December 16. Regular Decision: Application deadline: January 2. Decisions released March 31.

deadline.notes: Yale Admissions counselor sheet 'News, Numbers, and Financial Aid - 2026-2027 Information for Counselors' (PDF served at admissions.yale.edu/resource/download/400). The dates block is headed 'Important Dates 2026-2027' (the 2026-2027 admissions cycle, i.e. entry in fall 2027); the January 2 inside the 2026-2027 cycle, with decisions on March 31, is 2 January 2027. The date itself is printed without a year; the year comes from the printed cycle heading in the quote. No time zone stated. International applicants 'complete the same applications and fulfill the same application requirements as all other applicants' (admissions.yale.edu/international, KB documents source).
